Subject: Regional EDU webinar — speaker gift cards + shipping cost split

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Quick ask for the Sept 10 Midwest Education webinar we’re co-running with Midwest Education Alliance. We confirmed three external speakers and the partner (see Elena below) would like us to provide thank-you gift cards (~$75 each) plus cover insured overnight shipping for two speakers who are out-of-state.

Spend breakdown:
- Gift cards (3 x $75) = $225
- Shipping (2 x overnight insured, est $55 each) = $110
- Packaging/handling = $15
Total expected = $350 (rounded up to $380 to cover variance + tax)

Options I see:
1) Issue a small PO to GiftBox Co (vendor) for prepaid gift cards + shipping (they will ship directly to speaker addresses).
2) PCard purchase by MarComm and expense reconciliation (likely faster but we prefer PO when >$250 per procurement policy).

Can finance confirm preferred route? If PO is required, can you help route a PO for ~$380 to GiftBox Co under cost center 4302-ENG-MKT (field events)? If PCard is acceptable, Marissa can charge and submit receipts; we’ll still need cost center coding and any tax handling guidance.

Attachments: speaker_list.csv (names + addresses), proforma_invoice_GiftBox_0826.pdf (vendor estimate).

Need approval by EOD Thu (8/19) to meet vendor lead times.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Field Marketing Manager

Kimberly — thanks for the details. A few clarifying q's before I can approve routing: 

1) Is GiftBox Co set up in our vendor master? If not, we will need W-9 and vendor form; turnaround ~3 business days (could still make it if we start today).
2) Confirm whether the gift cards are taxable vendor spend or speaker honoraria (taxable to recipient). If taxable honoraria, we may need 1099 reporting and a different workflow.
3) Confirm the exact cost center string (4302-ENG-MKT vs 4302-MKT-REG) — finance needs the GL mapping to code the PO.

If PO path: we can put in a low-dollar PO and route for manager approval; choose PO amount = $400 to give buffer. If PCard path: Marissa can charge and we’ll code to cost center; finance prefers PCard under $500 for speed.

Please reply with vendor onboarding status + tax intent and I’ll pick the route.

- Cost center: Please use 4302-MKT-REG (this is the regional events code).

- Vendor: GiftBox Co
- Qty: 3 gift cards ($75 ea) + 2 insured shippings ($55 ea) + packaging handling = total $380
- Requestor: Kimberly Park; Campaign: Midwest EDU Webinar (Sep 10)
